scenario_description:
Objective: Keep tomorrow morning’s Meadowbrook ballot-drop wayfinding table from sending residents toward a staff-only loading drive.
Emerging Need: A routine tote plan becomes risky when the insert staged for Meadowbrook names a south-drive route while the public-facing setup remains elsewhere.
Decision Context: Stored material notes identify the approved insert, its rack location, the no-handwritten-substitute rule, the release route, and the last reversible tote-change time.
Consequence: Timely correction can keep the first public setup neutral and accurate; after staging closes a stop-use warning can still protect the first shift; first-public-display prevention ends only once residents have already seen the wrong insert.

parameter.title: Meadowbrook drop-box wayfinding table prep
parameter.description: On-site receipt check at 10:45, setup until 11:00, then public-resource table 11:00–12:00. Wayfinding insert selection is pending.

parameter.subject: Meadowbrook tote staging plan
parameter.body: Tote MBC-7 is open on Annex table 3 for tomorrow's Meadowbrook public-resource shift. Arrow insert and table cards will be packed after lunch; sign-rack picks should be on the staging log before the tote seal at 15:20 today.

parameter.content: I found a laminated yellow arrow insert clipped to the Meadowbrook packet. Text says “Ballot Drop Box — South Loading Drive.” I set it beside tote MBC-7 with the table cards for now; no current north-vestibule insert was in that pocket.

parameter.title: Meadowbrook drop-box wayfinding table prep
parameter.description: Meadowbrook facilities note added: public entry and the resource table will use the east lobby while the south loading drive remains staff-only during Friday morning setup.

parameter.subject: Meadowbrook tote MBC-7 sealed
parameter.body: The MBC-7 tote was sealed at 15:25 and delivered to Meadowbrook for the 10:45 receipt check tomorrow. The manifest still lists the South Loading Drive insert. Damon will open it at 10:45 and can withhold an insert before the public table opens at 11:00; the sealed tote cannot be repacked at Annex now.

parameter.content: The table opened at 11:00 with the South Loading Drive insert, and the first visitors followed it before facilities noticed. Staff removed the insert at 11:10 and are now directing visitors using the official north-vestibule directions. That first display has already occurred.
